_meta.name: gov-os base view tree, version 2
_meta.status: v2.2, 2026-09-10, owner-ruled at the architect's seat (board :3739; levels 3 and 4 re-cut, board :3760); structured form of design/25-VIEW-TREE.md VERSION 2; v1 file 25-view-tree.json untouched as history; v2.2 3817: seed_form per node (the oracle for VT-3 A3), the third view form ruled
_meta.purpose: views exist to ensure governance quality; every permanent node answers one governance question; a node that only re-indexes its parent does not exist
rulings: four master views at level 1: events, rules, items, relationships (two definitive kinds plus the master each throws off)
level 2 is one split per node, MECE; a product of a parent with a dimension is the parent re-indexed and lives at level 4
old rules are a permanent node (supersedes v1 ruling 3 'history is never a node'; later ruling controls; conflict shown)

level 3 is one axis everywhere: S/U (actor class on the event and rule sides; the item's own cell on the static side) [SUPERSEDED at v2.1: under 3 the class/cell split moved to level 4; the event and rule sides keep it at level 3]
actor top group is the class, never the top organisation; the group tree lives in relationships as containment rows
relationships are venn2 rows only and globally true: one fact, two signed halves, held at both ends; a single held half is a finding

a relation row's frame is the rule it was created under; reading = that rule's text; roles = actor/object/target; valid time = the creating and ending acts; transaction time = the recording moment; source = the signature
authority is never a relation row; parent-child is containment; who commands whom is a rule plus occupancies, computed

overlap is never a node: computed where scopes are structured, declared as a judgment row where scopes are text; real shared ground is promoted to an item [REFINED at v2.1: a declared overlap is a non-tree ROW under 4.x.3; computed overlap of scopes stays a check]
levels 1-3 permanent on disk as seeded view rows; level 4 and up in memory, saved only when a rule says so
an events master is not a view anyone binds to; nothing operational reads the raw record
level 2 is liveness on every derived master: rules, items, relationships split active/old by latest-wins; nothing erased
names are relations (non-tree rows under 4), never items; an item has one place in 3
level 3 under 3 is actors and static; class, kind and cell are level 4
level 3 under 4: actor tree, item tree (directional containment by ends), non-tree (touching, declared overlap, names, connections)

many parents lawful, none outside the tree: every actor and static item has at least one chain to the root in the governing frame; orphan or loop refused at the gate; a rule's scope reaches down every chain

the third view form: a DERIVED view row (from a parent view, narrowed by one closed derived dimension: actor_class, scope_class, item_kind, liveness, tree_kind) — design/28's system view given a row form; every level-3 node is one derive; level 1-2 nodes bind folds; level 4 is computed (board :3817)

not_nodes.overlap: a declared overlap is a non-tree ROW (4.x.3, geometry IN, a judgment act); overlap computed from two rules' scopes is a check at level 4, never a node
not_nodes.authority: never a relation row; a rule on roles plus occupancies, computed per call
not_nodes.permission: the may is computed per call (v1 ruling 5); grant rows are relations under 4.3
not_nodes.chains of effect: paths over 4.3 plus the record's own causation; level 4
not_nodes.frames: level 4; a frame is the rule a relation was created under
not_nodes.names: name-touches-thing rows under non-tree; a retired name is an old relationship; never an item

relation_row_target_shape.subject: item id
relation_row_target_shape.geometry: AD | IN | NS | EM (UR is absence, never stored)
relation_row_target_shape.zone: edge | core | unknown (computed when the frame's edge width is known, else asserted)
relation_row_target_shape.frame: the rule the relation was created under (derived from the creating act's rule_cited)

tiers.1_permanent: levels 1-3 above; seeded as view rows; on disk
tiers.2_memory: level 4 and up; computed; saved only when a rule says so (e.g. a user profile on a laptop)

live_checks: unchanged from v1: permission, sight, authority, due, wake, consistency — functions, never stored views

tree_invariant.governing_frame: the permission frame: the actor tree rooted at the constitution's root group; the item tree rooted at the mother space
tree_invariant.rule: every actor and every static item has AT LEAST ONE parent chain reaching the root; many parents lawful; an orphan or a loop is refused at the gate
tree_invariant.inheritance: a rule's scope reaches down every chain; colliding rules on one node via two chains are the overlap check's case

derived_dimensions.actor_class: the acting actor's declared class: program | human | ai
derived_dimensions.scope_class: the class a rule's scope names: program | human | ai | all
derived_dimensions.tree_kind: actor_tree | item_tree | non_tree (from geometry and ends)
